media-libs/vulkan-loader: Uprev to upstream ebuild 1.0.61.1 Newer versions of the Vulkan loader support more Vulkan instance extensions; and install a vulkan.pc file. When I added this package to CrOS last year, no upstream Gentoo ebuild existed yet. The diff between CrOS's ebuild and Gentoo's ebuild is so tiny that Gentoo probably copied CrOS's. Let's reduce unneccessary deviation from upstream, and just import Gentoo's ebuild. Changes from the upstream ebuild: @@ Preserve KEYWORDS from the original CrOS ebuild. -KEYWORDS="~amd64" +KEYWORDS="*" @@ Preserve PYTHON_COMPAT from the original CrOS ebuild. -PYTHON_COMPAT=( python3_{4,5} ) +PYTHON_COMPAT=( python3_{3,4,5,6} ) @@ Drop Python from DEPENDS because CrOS never adds host dependencies to DEPENDS. @@ CrOS does not have EAPI 6. Use 5. - EAPI=6 + EAPI=5 BUG=None TEST=Emerge and deploy vulkan-loader. Then run `deqp-vk -n dEQP-VK.api.smoke.*`. FROMGIT: mwifiex: double the size of chan_stats array in adapter When a user requests scan, driver sends multiple scan requests to firmware, which might be active or passive. Firmware will send channel statistics for each channel in the request. This will be stored in chan_stats array. Few channels might report hidden SSIDs in passive scan results. So, once the original scan request is finished, driver issues an active scan request for all channels which reported hidden SSIDs. This will cause duplicates in the chan_stats array. At worst, every channel will have a hidden SSID, in which case the driver can issue active scan requests for each channel. So the complete scan statistics size will be twice of existing limit. At present maximum number of channels returned in scan statistics is 31(BG) + 14(A) = 45. Clearly there will be an overflow of the chan_stats array in the above mentioned scenario. To fix this double the size of chan_stats array. Signed-off-by: Rohit Fule <rohitf@marvell.com> Signed-off-by: Mangesh Malusare <mmangesh@marvell.com> Signed-off-by: Ganapathi Bhat <gbhat@marvell.com> Signed-off-by: Kalle Valo <kvalo@codeaurora.org> (cherry picked from git://git.kernel.org/pub/scm/linux/kernel/git/kvalo/wireless-drivers-next.git commit 2d5cc60949e0d2de3cb05d5772b58a5aa7f4abc3) BUG=b:63081833 TEST=kevin Wifi; scan mwifiex debug logs for "FW reported too many channel results" warnings Change-Id: If6a90f361b01c221767a2c6e3c90a30f6816022a Signed-off-by: Brian Norris <briannorris@chromium.org> Reviewed-on: https://chromium-review.googlesource.com/719421
